# openwrt_file (Data Source)

Reads a file from the router. Content is always sensitive; use the `openwrt_file` ephemeral resource to keep it out of state entirely.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String)

### Read-Only

- `content` (String, Sensitive)
- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive)
- `md5` (String)
- `mode` (String)
- `size` (Number)
